insight: Reached general availability on April 16, 2025 — the same day JetBrains added a free AI tier across its IDEs.
name: Junie
tagline: Autonomous AI coding agent built into JetBrains IDEs.
description: JetBrains' agentic coding assistant that plans and executes multi-step tasks — writing code, running tests, refactoring, and debugging — from natural-language prompts inside the IDE. Runs natively in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, PyCharm Pro, WebStorm, GoLand, and other JetBrains editors, drawing on their deep project indexes. Included with JetBrains AI subscriptions.

modelSupport.notes: Backed by JetBrains AI; Ultimate tier adds a Claude-powered agent mode.

edge: Runs natively inside JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand), pairing an autonomous agent with their deep project indexes.
